item.title: 08/082026. Vicarage Road Health & Safety issue dangerous temporary roadworks traffic lights faulty time sequence. After entering the roadworks section on bicycle on GREEN traffic light I was halfway up the hill alongside the roadworks when traffic was released on green in the opposite direction. The lead oncoming vehicle sped by coming toward me at speed and forced me off my bike into the barriers narrowly avoiding serious injury or death.. The traffic is being released in the opposite direction too soon and does not allow cyclists time to traverse the long uphill roadworks. This has been reported before and has not been fixed and the latest incident CANNOT be ignored and action must be taken to make the site safe for cyclists by altering the traffic light sequence to allow sufficient time for cyclists or providing a temporary dedicated safe lane for cyclists., 8th August

item.title: Multiple fly tipping near underpass at bottom of Sandcliffe Road, 8th August
item.description:
There are multiple piles of fly tipping. One is on the grass verge near the underpass, where lots of old tyres have been dumped. Not sure if this has come from either car business. Second is a pile slightly further up on the same side next to the block of flats. It's bags of clothes, a vacuum cleaner etc. Last is one of the tyres on the other side of the underpass.
